scienceAndPremiseUnits.requirement: Reducing androgen supply and directly antagonizing the receptor intervene at different molecular locations.
Intracellular full-length AR has distinct ligand-binding and DNA-binding regions;its nuclear transcription route is conditional on receptor form,partners and cell context.
AR amount,location,transcription,LAR classification and growth dependence answer different measurement questions.
A splice variant can lack a relevant ligand-binding region;the variant cartoon does not define every variant or response.
Prostate-mechanism evidence and trial-specific breast-cancer observations retain their disease,intervention and population boundaries.
A clinical-benefit-rate endpoint can include qualifying stability;it is not automatically a shrinkage rate or randomized survival comparison.
The hormone,antagonist and receptor outlines locate interventions rather than show atomic binding geometry or a drug-selection rule.

The shared AR domain inset and intervention-location view serve different explanatory tasks;historical no-existing-art statements are assessed at their recorded time rather than as current universal facts.
CDK4/6-mediated RB phosphorylation participates in G1-to-S control;inhibition can preserve an arrest route when the necessary machinery works.
RB protein presence does not prove an intact working arrest circuit or a clinical response.
CDK2 with cyclin partners participates in progression around DNA copying;more cyclin E does not prove sensitivity to every CDK2 inhibitor.
CDK7 contributes to transcription initiation and activation of other CDKs;its roles cross the two drawn categories.
CDK9 supports transcription elongation and pause release rather than being interchangeable with CDK4/6.
The family name does not specify a compound target profile,achieved exposure or cellular effect.
Pause followed by regrowth after washout supports reversible arrest,not demonstrated irreversible cell death.
Marrow protection and duration of severe neutropenia are different endpoints from tumor shrinkage,survival and clinical tumor control.
The two selected-role tracks are not exhaustive or exclusive job assignments,and their spacing is not a measured timetable.
The protected cycle reference separates optional G0 and relative DNA-content groups from a division-rate measurement;it does not itself locate all transcription jobs.
An extracellular antibody contact and an intracellular kinase-inhibitor contact reach different regions of a membrane-spanning EGFR example.
Antibody,TKI and conjugate results retain their actual mechanism and product evidence rather than inheriting one another efficacy.
Target recognition can support payload delivery without establishing dependence on EGFR kinase signaling.
Protein staining,an activating variant,phosphorylation,growth dependence and patient benefit are separate claims.
A single drawn receptor is a location schematic;the cited asymmetric kinase-domain mechanism does not make that drawing activation stoichiometry for every RTK.
Lower phosphorylation with unchanged growth can support a biochemical effect without demonstrating growth sensitivity.
Mechanism studies,lung-cancer activating variants and metastatic TNBC trials retain separate disease,format and endpoint scopes.
Cargo movement and receptor processing are simplified;the drawing does not establish a complete trafficking sequence or molecular structure.
PAR is a poly(ADP-ribose) signal polymer rather than DNA,RNA or ATP;PARP1 is the representative enzyme in these scenes.
Catalytic inhibition reduces PAR synthesis;PAR-level assays investigate catalytic-product output under specified conditions.
Trapping describes a stabilized protein-DNA association,not an irreversible covalent drug-DNA bridge.
Catalytic inhibition and DNA retention can coexist;these are related measurement questions rather than two exclusive clinical drug classes.
Both catalytic-output scenes intentionally show DNA-bound PARP1;the chain-length comparison alone does not measure dissociation or residence time.
The occupied duplex lies ahead of the conceptual copying machinery,with a pre-encounter gap;the image does not show a measured collision or guaranteed stall.
Exposure,current repair function and additional responses determine consequences;an occupancy observation alone does not establish damage,death or benefit.
A historical genomic scar and current repair function are different quantities;repair restoration can change a vulnerability despite prior damage history.
Experimental trapping comparisons cannot rank the best medicine or clinical benefit for a person.
PARP1 is representative,not a complete family model or a universal atomic/domain geometry.
Qualitative PAR chains and simplified daughter-DNA paths are not measured assay values or a leading/lagging-strand reconstruction.
The source-specific fork-obstacle explanation is a conceptual model;the broader retained gap-model and clinical-label clauses are outside fresh certification by these prompt reads.
Class I PI3K modifies membrane PIP2 to PIP3;this lipid step differs from protein phosphorylation.
PTEN opposes the PIP3 lipid signal by removing the position-3 phosphate.
AKT is a protein kinase,distinct from the upstream lipid-kinase job of PI3K.
Recruitment and phosphorylation at specified AKT sites are distinct;one phosphosite is not a universal activity meter.
The AKT-to-mTORC1 connection is indirect through regulatory intermediates,not a direct universal phosphorylation arrow.
The returning brake summarizes indirect negative feedback on upstream signaling rather than every network branch or direct mTORC1-to-receptor phosphorylation.
Reducing mTORC1 can relieve a feedback brake and increase upstream AKT signaling in studied systems;rebound is not universal.
A named phosphosite,target engagement,growth dependence and patient benefit require distinct evidence.
Neighboring PI3K,AKT and mTOR inhibitors are not interchangeable,and a pathway-associated variant alone does not establish drug benefit or eligibility.
The fictional lower output and higher AKT-site observation is compatible with a network response but does not prove that feedback wiring in the sample.
ATR-associated signaling responds to replication stress at stalled copying machinery.
WEE1 adds an inhibitory phosphate to a CDK to help hold cell-cycle progression.
POLtheta supports end joining of exposed DNA ends using short matching sequences.
Stress signaling,checkpoint control and end joining are distinct parallel jobs rather than one mandatory linear DDR pipeline.
Inhibition bars locate possible target-blocking sites,not clinical doses,measured inhibition strengths or guaranteed outcomes.
Current repair function needs its own test;historical scar status does not establish present dependency.
PARP resistance alone does not establish POLtheta sensitivity;BRCA2-reversion models and53BP1/Shieldin-loss models retain their distinct tested resistance boundaries.
The actual POLtheta compound and targeted protein function matter;ART558 polymerase work and novobiocin work are not interchangeable evidence.
Short matches,DNA strokes and join arrows are schematic rather than literal bases,error-free repair or a complete network.
A TP53 mechanism rationale does not establish a validated treatment-selection rule,and distinct targets do not guarantee nonoverlapping normal-tissue toxicity.
Keep both pinned path/byte/blob/hash identities and reuse a read only by exact content identity.
A cited hash matching historical or other-scope bytes is not automatically corruption or proof of current owner review.
Preserve literal creative attribution separately from scientific author,reviewer and integrator roles;do not infer original identity where unproved.
Historical PASS,approval and review booleans do not provide current human,owner,scientific or independent acceptance.
The seven ZIP members exactly duplicate acknowledged loose bodies;the package does not contain all private args,tool results or source figures and is not a complete executable replay.

Specific PARP four-call light/dark lineage and own-light reference hashes remain separate from generic code-generated/no-model prose. An identical dark-edit prompt does not by itself prove geometry or quantity equality.
Historical focus-to-BODY and Tab reports remain recorded reports;no fresh browser or comprehensive accessibility review is claimed.
The two selected PARP index rows say dark Not found despite actual pinned dark PNGs;only13 complete selected index rows per pin,not the whole index,were read.
